Question: Privacy Policy explicitly discloses Google AdSense and cookies
Evidence: Section 6 "Cookies & Advertising" explicitly names Google AdSense, explains ad cookies, links to adssettings.google.com and google.com/policies/privacy/partners. Full AdSense-compliant disclosure present.

Question: Terms of Service page exists

Question: No adult / violence / gambling / drugs / weapons content in page text
Evidence: backlink-analyzer.tsx contains const SPAMMY_PATTERNS = ["casino", "poker", "bet", "loan", "pills", "pharma", "viagra", "xxx", "porn", "adult", "gambling"] as a JavaScript data array used to detect spam backlinks — it is not rendered as page text. Question: No hidden text or white-on-white keyword stuffing
Evidence: All opacity-0 and display:none instances are UI transitions (hover effects, loading spinners, animated components). No content is hidden from users while visible to crawlers.

Question: No user-agent cloaking (different content served to bots vs users)
Evidence: No navigator.userAgent checks that alter page content. No server-side bot detection in Express routes beyond standard rate limiting.

Question: AdSense script is in head with the correct publisher ID
Evidence: index.html: <script async src="https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-9994285234413878" crossorigin="anonymous"> correctly placed in <head>.

Question: ads.txt matches the publisher ID exactly
Evidence: ads.txt: google.com, pub-9994285234413878, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0 — publisher ID matches and format is correct.

Question: No suspicious non-Google third-party ad scripts present
Evidence: Only AdSense (pagead2.googlesyndication.com) and Google Tag Manager (gtag.js) in index.html. GTM configured with anonymize_ip: true and ad personalization signals disabled. CSP in vercel.json whitelists only Google ad domains.

Question: Ads do not create intrusive interstitials that block content
Evidence: CookieBanner slides in from the bottom with a 1.2-second delay — not a full-screen interstitial. No modals fire on tool page load. No useEffect popups detected on content pages.

Question: Admin panel is protected from public indexing
Evidence: robots.txt: Disallow: /admin for all crawlers. /admin not in prerender.mjs. Frontend shows a password form; all data API endpoints require x-admin-password request header.

Question: All public pages are included in the sitemap
Evidence: sitemap.xml splits into 4 sub-sitemaps: sitemap-pages.xml, sitemap-tools.xml, sitemap-blog.xml, sitemap-images.xml. prerender.mjs generates static HTML for 36 explicit paths plus all dynamic tool registry paths. Both sitemap URLs declared in robots.txt.

Question: robots.txt allows Googlebot to crawl all public pages
Evidence: User-agent: * Allow: / and User-agent: Googlebot Allow: / confirmed. Only /api/ and /admin are blocked. 16 AI training bots (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, CCBot, etc.) separately blocked.

Question: noindex is used only on pages that should be excluded from search
Evidence: Only not-found.tsx (404 page) sets noindex nofollow. All tool pages

Question: HTTPS is enforced site-wide
Evidence: vercel.json redirects HTTP → HTTPS via x-forwarded-proto header check. HSTS header: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload.

Question: Every page has a unique title and meta description
Evidence: prerender.mjs injects per-page seoTitle and seoDescription from the tool manifest at build time. Tool pages set these via MiniToolLayout props. All 12 blog posts have unique titles. No duplicate title/description pairs found.

Question: Per-page seoKeywords are set (not just the site-wide fallback)
Evidence: regex-tester.tsx has explicit seoKeywords set. Most other tool pages (base64, uuid-generator, json-formatter, color-picker, image-compressor, password-generator, etc.) do not set seoKeywords and fall back to the site-wide keyword string from index.html. Not a ranking factor (Google ignores meta keywords) but inconsistent coverage.
Fix Required: Add seoKeywords to each tool page that currently relies on the site-wide fallback (low priority — not a search ranking signal)

Question: Structured data is correct and complete
Evidence: index.html contains: WebSite (with SearchAction), Organization, WebApplication, and ItemList schemas. MiniToolLayout generates a BreadcrumbList schema per tool page. All use correct schema.org types and required properties.

Question: lang=""en"" is declared on the HTML element
Evidence: <html lang="en"> confirmed in index.html.

Evidence: Global canonical <link rel="canonical" href="https://xtoolkit.live/"> in index.html. MiniToolLayout and BlogLayout each render a page-specific canonical URL.

Question: Authorship and creator identity are established
Evidence: About page names "Somen", describes background as an independent developer, and states the project started in May 2026. Sufficient E-A-T for a utility tool site.

Question: No 404 errors on key routes
Evidence: 404 page exists (not-found.tsx) with noindex. All routes in App.tsx map to real page component files.

Question: Site is mobile-friendly
